description: Quick booking, easy payments, and total control of your weekend. Fully licensed & insured for stress-free stag, hen and group trips abroad.
h1: Epic Stag & Hen Do's and Group Holidays
paragraphs: Infinity Weekends create unforgettable stag, hen and group trips across the UK and Europe. Based in Benidorm, our team live and breathe these destinations, so every package comes from real experience — not guesswork.
We’ve been doing this for over 20 years and know exactly what makes a weekend one to remember.

We’ve been sending groups away for over two decades — and we still love every minute of it. From our base in Benidorm, we live what we sell — so when we recommend an activity, hotel or night out, it’s because we’ve done it ourselves.
Booking with Infinity means you’re not just getting a package; you’re dealing with people who know how to make a weekend run smoothly.

From Spain’s sun-soaked beaches to lively UK cities, our destinations suit every kind of weekend. Whether it’s a wild stag do, a glamorous hen party, or a big group getaway, we’ll help you find the right spot for your crew.
